seed '_word_seed(KLEIN_SEED, w)' hashes a token to a scalar then mints a random vector -- the F1260 word-hash anti-pattern. These sites use the vector as an ATOMIC ADDRESS (retrieved by exact-identity argmax), never comparing two different tokens' vectors, so klein4_address is the faithful regime -- NOT klein4_encode_bytes, which would inject morphological similarity the experiment does not want. klein4_address also removes the narrow-seed-band aliasing and (for builtin hash) the PYTHONHASHSEED non-reproducibility.
